item.title: Test Single Post Layout
item.description:
Single Post Template Test

Template: layouts/_test/single.html (or fallback layouts/post/single.html or layouts/single.html) Base: layouts/baseof.html

This page tests the single post template with all typical front matter fields populated.

Post Metadata Test

Check the header above. It should display:

  • ✅ Post title
  • ✅ Publication date (January 15, 2025)
  • ✅ Categories (Testing, Development)
  • ✅ Tags (theme, components, testing, hugo)

Content Area Test

This is the main content area. It should be wrapped in the .content CSS class and display properly formatted text.

item.title: Moving My Personal Blog From Wordpress to Hugo
item.description: I started the process of moving my personal blog over a year ago, when the global pandemic brought on by the COVID-19 virus sent my local area into lock down. The reasons for doing so were simple enough, my web hosting bill had grown north of $200 dollars a month for my personal blog. Don’t get me wrong, Wordpress is great! I just wanted to get my blog onto something more appropriate for the audience (read, pretty small).
